title: Shoot Apical Meristem: Zones, Stem-Cell Maintenance and Organ Initiation
word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited visible words in p.teaching-prose only; separately counted article text excludes SVG content; headings, practice, answers, tables, references, revision excluded from teaching count.

validation.comparator: 5.B.13; 14,087 marked teaching words at initial inspection

review_pass_1: Internal scientific and syllabus review; confirmed official 2026 merged and separate syllabi; primary-source checks on WUS, CLV feedback and ligand-receptor interaction, mature peptide, protein mobility and classic auxin experiments. Corrected attribution of vegetative tomato and reproductive Arabidopsis experiments and recomputed all worked examples including replicate means and treatment reductions.
review_pass_2: Internal teaching and exam review; reviewed organization, state-versus-lineage distinctions, comparison with 5.B.13, 52 explanations, traps, active recall and diagrams; corrected ambiguous lineage distractor, added controlled rescue dataset, audited actual saved HTML and answer positions, IDs, anchors, zoom, ARIA and script syntax.

quality.type: internal editorial assessment, not external peer review
quality.deductions: Selective primary-source full-text access; some concepts revisited; simplified quantitative models and hypothetical data; questions uncalibrated and some distractors relatively direct; static rather than interactive browser/device validation.

limitations: MP SET 2024 mirrored syllabus consulted; current official state-host document not independently verified.
Selective full-text primary-source access; external peer review and question calibration not performed.
Hypothetical datasets and simplified models explicitly marked.
Interactive browser and device behavior not independently tested.
Pages deployment and live verification separate from commit.
